scope: Self-assessment of every Passing/Silver/Gold item on official /en/criteria, including suggestions; not an application, badge or product security certification. Separate OSPS Baseline controls acquired for research are not claimed as a completed OSPS assessment.

statusDefinitions.Met: Evidence supports the stated bounded criterion, not a badge
statusDefinitions.Partial: Known evidence covers only part; not a pass
statusDefinitions.Unmet: Observed counterexample or absent required documented mechanism
statusDefinitions.Unknown: Required truth/evidence not established; not false or zero
statusDefinitions.Not applicable: Official conditional criterion permits exclusion and reason provided

application.limitation: Exact URL search and Scorecard do not prove absence under a different project URL/name; no external registration performed

owners: Each row names the accountable role for addressing/confirming it. wakaken is the observed repository admin; a formal security-response or backup appointment is not inferred. Main agent authored this assessment.
